t041.sum: Free will is the power of choice that the Universal Father gives together with personality. God himself is the original personality with absolute free will, and man shares that will on a relative and finite level. Especially in matters of eternal survival the mortal's choice holds a sovereignty that no being can invade, so free will becomes the key by which man builds his own destiny.
t041.s1.i1: God is not an automatic force bound by law but the original personality possessed of free will.
t041.s1.i2: God's free will is conditioned only by his own divine nature and perfect attributes.
t041.s1.i3: He shares personality and goodness with his creatures, but infinity of will belongs to God alone.
t041.s1.i4: Even though God foreknows the acts of his children, that foreknowledge does not abrogate their freedom.
t041.s2.h: The Gift of Choice Given to Personality
t041.s2.i1: The two marks that distinguish creature personality are self-consciousness and the associated relative free will.
t041.s2.i2: Man's relative free will relates to such higher functions as moral decision, spiritual choice, unselfish love, and worship.
t041.s2.i3: The bestowal of personality adds to a living organism the prerogatives of self-determination and self-evolution.
t041.s3.h: A Will That No One Invades
t041.s3.i1: God has decreed that in matters of eternal survival no being or force can interfere with the free will of a mortal.
t041.s3.i3: The Adjuster brings a plan for the ideal life but never arbitrarily moves man's choices; it always respects his will.
t041.s3.i5: Angels, too, do not invade the sanctity of the human mind or manipulate the will, and they have no authority to curtail the prerogatives of choice.
t041.s3.i6: Even a rebel like Caligastia could not force a normal person to do anything against that person's will.
t041.s4.i1: True liberty is the reward of evolutionary progress; false liberty is a subtle deception born of the errors of time.
t041.s4.i3: Liberty without self-mastery is an illusion, and license masquerading as liberty is the forerunner of bondage.
t041.s4.i4: The Lucifer rebellion paraded as liberty, but in reality it threatened to rob creatures of their freewill participation.
t041.s4.i5: Sin arises from an immaturity that, dazzled by freedom of the will, fails to grasp the obligations of universe citizenship.
t041.s5.h: The Responsibility of Choice and Destiny
t041.s5.i1: Energy systems have no choice, but man, by the choices of his free will, has everything to do with determining his own destiny.
t041.s5.i2: The power of choice is both the greatest opportunity and the supreme responsibility, and the Adjuster, the Father, and the Supreme Being depend on its faithfulness.
t041.s5.i3: On the lower levels the range of choice is narrow, but as one ascends the universe, choice becomes ever freer.
t041.s5.i4: Choosing the will of God is not the surrender of will but its consecration, enlargement, and perfection.
t042.sum: Survival means that the mortal personality, beyond the death of the flesh, awakens again in the morontia worlds and continues the eternal ascent. The Urantia Book teaches that survival is a gift of God, but a gift that man must desire and choose for himself. What survives is the soul built together with the Adjuster, and the key to it is not knowledge or doctrine but the sincere determination to find God and be like him, and a living faith.
t042.s1.i2: Human identity is real only in so far as the personality chooses to become a continuing universe phenomenon, and that path must be pursued by free will.
t042.s1.i3: Personality is destined for a divine goal, but man must choose for himself whether he will be present where that goal is attained.
t042.s1.i4: The capacity to reject survival did not arise with the Lucifer rebellion; it is an endowment of choice that mortals have always possessed.
t042.s2.i1: The reality that survives the death of the material body and mind is the soul, the morontia self born of man and the Adjuster together.
t042.s2.i2: After death the Adjuster goes to Divinington bearing the memory transcript of the life, and the soul is held by the guardian of destiny.
t042.s2.i3: The surviving self evolves only by transferring the seat of identity from the material body to the immortal morontia soul.
t042.s2.i4: Memories without spiritual meaning perish with the brain, but memories of relationships between personalities have cosmic value and remain.
t042.s2.i5: Man survives mortal death by the identification of his identity with the indwelling spark of divinity.
t042.s3.i2: Success or failure in survival depends less on theories of belief than on decisions, determinations, and steadfast faith.
t042.s3.i4: Ignorance, confusion, or fearful doubt alone cannot prevent the survival of the God-knowing soul.
t042.s3.i5: Doing the will of God is the secret of survival and of perfection in survival.
t042.s4.h: Faith and the Assurance of Survival
t042.s4.i1: Religious experience leads at last to a sure consciousness of God and an undoubted assurance of the survival of the believing personality.
t042.s4.i2: Jesus taught that once one has established himself by faith as a son of God, there is nothing more to worry about regarding the certainty of survival.
t042.s4.i3: The risen Jesus said that survival depends first on being born of the spirit that seeks truth and God.
t042.s4.i5: The faith-activated soul cannot stop, because it has the task of finding God, and once it reaches the goal it can never end.
t042.s5.h: Merciful Adjudication and the Orders of Survival
t042.s5.i1: Every will creature is sure to experience one genuine opportunity to make an unquestioned final choice.
t042.s5.i2: Those who, through no fault of their own, have not mastered the circles on earth are given extended probation if they have the will to survive.
t042.s5.i3: When a verdict is in doubt, the universe government always decides in favor of the individual.
t042.s5.i4: Survivors reach the mansion worlds in several orders, among them dispensational group roll calls, individual ascensions, and probationary dependents.
t042.s5.i5: Those who attained the third circle or higher and received personal guardians may be repersonalized on the mansion worlds on the third day after death.
t043.sum: In The Urantia Book death is not an end but a doorway from the material life to the morontia life. For primitive man death was the supreme shock and the greatest fear, and it gave rise to the development of religion; revelation, however, shows that there are three kinds of death, spiritual, intellectual, and physical, and that the surviving soul sleeps and then awakens again on the mansion worlds. On advanced worlds even natural death becomes increasingly rare.
t043.s1.h: Primitive Man and the Fear of Death
t043.s1.i2: Not the sanctity of life but the fear inspired by the shock of death fostered early religion.
t043.s1.i3: Fearing the ghosts released by death, primitive peoples destroyed the dead person's house and took a different road home from the funeral.
t043.s1.i4: The concept of a future life, derived from dreams, began to soften the fear of death bound up with the instinct of self-preservation.
t043.s1.i5: The basic belief of primitive religion was survival after death.
t043.s2.i1: In relation to personality survival there are three kinds of death: spiritual (soul) death, intellectual (mind) death, and physical (body and mind) death.
t043.s2.i2: One who has finally rejected survival is, from the universe point of view, already dead, even while the body lives.
t043.s2.i3: When the mind circuits that make volitional action possible are irretrievably destroyed, the Adjuster departs, and this too is death.
t043.s2.i4: In physical death the Adjuster remains until the mind ceases to function, then departs for Divinington when the life pulsations of the brain stop.
t043.s3.i1: The body returns to the elements, but two nonmaterial factors continue: the Adjuster and the morontia soul.
t043.s3.i3: From death until repersonalization the surviving soul is wholly unconscious, in the keeping of the guardian of destiny.
t043.s3.i4: Those who go to the mansion worlds cannot send messages back to their loved ones on earth; such communication is forbidden.
t043.s3.i5: In the resurrection halls the morontia form, the returning Adjuster, and the conserved soul are united, and identity is reassembled.
t043.s4.h: The Eye of Faith on Death
t043.s4.i1: The spirit of adventure and the dread of monotony were placed in man to suggest that death is only the beginning of an endless career of adventure.
t043.s4.i2: Life after death is not essentially different from mortal existence, and every good thing done now enhances the future life.
t043.s4.i3: True religion does not foster spiritual sloth through the vain hope of gaining noble virtues merely by passing through the portals of death.
t043.s4.i4: Jesus taught that believers should live as if pursuing their careers with natural death always in prospect.
t043.s5.i2: On worlds settled in light and life, many fuse with their Adjusters and are translated alive into the morontia state.
t043.s5.i3: On such worlds a "funeral" becomes an occasion not of weeping but of joy, deep satisfaction, and inexpressible hope.
t043.s5.i4: Less advanced mortals would be helped if they too learned to view natural death with such cheerfulness and lightness of heart.
t043.s5.i5: Yet even on long-settled worlds there is no system in which natural death as a way of leaving the flesh has wholly disappeared.
t044.sum: The mansion worlds are the seven transition worlds surrounding Jerusem, the capital of the local system, and they correspond to the "many mansions in my Father's house" of which Jesus spoke. After death the surviving mortal awakens in the resurrection halls of the first mansion world, makes up the deficiencies left unfinished on earth, and, passing through the seven worlds in turn, becomes less and less mortal and more and more morontial. This is the first school of the ascension, linking the material life with the spirit life.
t044.s1.h: What the Seven Mansion Worlds Are
t044.s1.i1: The "many mansions" of which Jesus spoke refer especially to the seven satellites of the first transition world surrounding Jerusem.
t044.s1.i2: The mansion worlds are in the charge of the morontia supervisors and the Melchizedeks, and each world has an acting governor and headquarters for many groups of ministers.
t044.s1.i3: When a system is settled in light and life, the mansion worlds one by one cease to serve as training spheres and are taken over by the finaliters.
t044.s1.i4: The seven worlds are in fact demortalizing spheres: on the first one is still largely human, but by graduation one has become nearly morontial.
t044.s2.h: Awakening on the First Mansion World
t044.s2.i1: At the center of the first mansion world stand the resurrection halls, the temple of personality assembly, where guardian seraphim, Adjusters, and archangels work together.
t044.s2.i2: The sleeping survivor is resurrected when the morontia soul kept by the seraphim and the spirit-mind held by the Adjuster are reunited.
t044.s2.i4: The resurrected one is granted ten days of liberty to explore the new home and look up loved ones who have gone before.
t044.s2.i5: Morontia companions are assigned to the ascenders as their friendly associates and guides.
t044.s3.i1: The experience of the first mansion world is almost wholly devoted to correcting the defects of character and deficiencies of experience left from the life in the flesh.
t044.s3.i2: No ascender can escape the experience of rearing children, and fathers must pass through it as surely as mothers.
t044.s3.i4: The second mansion world is devoted to removing intellectual conflicts and healing every kind of mental disharmony.
t044.s3.i5: Whereas the first two worlds give negative training to make up deficiencies, truly progressive morontia culture begins on the third world.
t044.s4.i1: With each move to a new world one goes to sleep and awakens in a new morontia body, but at these times the Adjuster does not leave.
t044.s4.i2: Memories of survival value are kept throughout the ascending career because the Adjuster has made counterparts of them.
t044.s4.i3: In the morontia body one still eats, drinks, and rests, but the food is completely utilized and leaves no residue.
t044.s4.i4: On the fourth world ascenders first learn true social life, based not on selfish conquest but on mutual appreciation and unselfish service.
t044.s4.i6: Fusion with the Adjuster is often actually effected on the fifth or sixth world, followed by the declaration, "This is a beloved son in whom I am well pleased."
t044.s5.i1: On the seventh mansion world the remnants of unfortunate heredity and unwholesome environment are cleansed away, and differences of world origin disappear.
t044.s5.i2: On the seventh world ascenders visit the Father's world and begin a more spiritual worship of the invisible Father.
t044.s5.i3: The graduates are sent off in classes from the sea of glass and welcomed as citizens of Jerusem.
t044.s5.i4: Those who pass through all the mansion worlds experience the adjustment sleep and the resurrection awakening seven times, after which consciousness is never again broken.
t045.sum: Morontia is the vast intermediate level lying between the material and the spiritual. Since God does not change a mortal of animal origin into a perfect spirit in a single step, the surviving human passes through the many morontia worlds of the local universe and, by hundreds of gradual transformations, reaches the threshold of spirit. The morontia life actually begins on earth when the soul is conceived, and its philosophic insight is called mota.
t045.s1.h: A Level Between Matter and Spirit
t045.s1.i2: Morontia is a broad level of reality that may be personal or impersonal, and may consist of living or nonliving energies.
t045.s1.i3: The morontia worlds are architectural spheres furnished with one hundred physical elements plus one hundred organizations of energy known as morontia materials.
t045.s1.i4: Like the "better and more enduring substance" of which Paul spoke, morontia material is real and literal.
t045.s1.i5: Morontia mind is a dual mind in which material and spiritual minds co-operate, governed by a single will.
t045.s2.h: Why a Morontia Stage Is Needed
t045.s2.i1: The Gods do not transform creatures of animal origin into perfect spirits at once by some mysterious magic.
t045.s2.i2: The belief that the single step of death instantly transforms the mortal mind into a perfected spirit is ignorant superstition.
t045.s2.i3: A morontia transition always intervenes between mortal state and spirit status, and its purpose is similar in all local creations.
t045.s2.i4: The morontia career is the transition life between evolutionary material existence and the higher spirit attainment.
t045.s3.i1: The morontia power supervisors provide 570 successive morontia bodies during the morontia career in Nebadon.
t045.s3.i2: In mortal life the spirit indwells almost as something separate, but in the morontia life the spirit becomes an actual part of the personality.
t045.s3.i3: Early morontia life resembles the material worlds, but on the constellation and Salvington it reaches increasingly spiritual levels.
t045.s3.i4: The body that the risen Jesus bore was also a morontia body: no blood circulated in it and it did not take material food, yet it was real.
t045.s4.h: Those Who Help the Morontia Life
t045.s4.i1: Morontia companions are offspring of the local universe Mother Spirit, friendly associates, guides, and interpreters for the ascenders.
t045.s4.i2: The mansion world teachers are cherubim and sanobim left behind by their seraphim, and they conduct the schools of thinking, feeling, and doing.
t045.s4.i4: The morontia career seeks to eradicate forever such animal vestiges as procrastination, insincerity, and the avoidance of problems.
t045.s4.i5: Transition seraphim help with the choice of a course, yet they respect the ascender's freewill choices as long as no harm results.
t045.s5.i1: Mota is an insight superior to philosophy; as two eyes are to one, it gives stereoscopic depth to meanings and values.
t045.s5.i2: On the first mansion world mota concepts are taught side by side with the corresponding statements of human philosophy.
t045.s5.i4: The morontia life actually begins on earth at the moment the Adjuster comes to indwell and the soul is conceived.
t045.s5.i5: After graduating from the mansion worlds and until attaining spirit status, the ascender is called a morontia progressor.
t045.s5.i6: The purpose of this long training is not merely eternal ease but preparation for the transcendent service of future ages.
t046.sum: The mortal ascension is the long road by which a human being of animal origin sets out from an evolutionary planet, passes through the mansion worlds and the morontia worlds of the local universe, the spirit training worlds of the superuniverse, and the central universe of Havona, and at last finds the Universal Father on Paradise and becomes a finaliter. The command "Be you perfect, even as I am perfect" is both the starting point and the goal of this journey, and the way must be walked step by step in experience.
t046.s1.i1: The will creatures of all the universes have embarked on the eternal adventure of reaching God the Father, the long journey to Paradise.
t046.s1.i2: Striving for the perfection of divinity should be the first duty and highest ambition of every creature.
t046.s1.i3: Though man cannot be perfect in the infinite sense, he can fully attain the divine goal that God has set for him.
t046.s2.h: An Outline of the Seven Stages
t046.s2.i1: The ascending career is summed up in seven stages: planetary mortals, sleeping survivors, mansion world students, morontia progressors, superuniverse wards, Havona pilgrims, and Paradise arrivals.
t046.s2.i2: For sleeping survivors the passing of time does not matter; one who has slept five thousand years awakens no differently from one who has rested five days.
t046.s2.i3: Ascenders progress individually within a sphere, but between the stages of universe study they always move in classes.
t046.s2.i4: Just before leaving the local universe they acquire true spirit identity, and from then on the ascender's status is forever settled.
t046.s3.h: Through the Local Universe and the Superuniverse
t046.s3.i1: Passing from the mansion worlds through the spheres of the system, the constellation, and the universe headquarters, the ascender as a morontia progressor develops in intellect, spirit, and form.
t046.s3.i3: On the superuniverse training worlds the young spirits share what they have learned with others and master local universe and superuniverse administration.
t046.s4.i1: The journey from superuniverse headquarters to Havona is always made alone, and the instruction of Havona is personal and individual.
t046.s4.i2: The pilgrim arrives in Havona possessing only one perfection, perfection of purpose, and his faith has already been tested.
t046.s4.i4: Attaining the Universal Father on the third circle of Havona, with the help of the Father guides, becomes the passport to eternity.
t046.s4.i5: Residence on Paradise means that God has been found, and Father-fused mortals are mustered into the mortal Corps of the Finality.
t046.s5.h: The Purpose of the Journey and Beyond
t046.s5.i1: Step by step, life by life, world by world, the ascending career is mastered and the goal of Deity is attained, and survival is completed in perfection.
t046.s5.i2: Finaliters are recorded as spirits of the sixth stage, so a destiny of the unrevealed seventh stage still remains.
t046.s5.i3: The long and tremendous training of the ascension must surely be designed to fit them for tests of greater trust and more sublime service.
t046.s5.i4: The destinies of Adjuster-fused, Son-fused, and Spirit-fused mortals differ, but none is greater or lesser, for God loves all his sons alike.
t046.s5.i5: Every facility and power is provided so that the Paradise goal of divine perfection may at last be attained.
t047.sum: Sonship with God is the family relationship between the heavenly Father and the individual that becomes real when a person accepts God as Father by faith. At the center of the gospel of the kingdom that Jesus proclaimed stand the fatherhood of God and the sonship of man that follows from it. This sonship is not earned by deeds but received as a gift, and the indwelling Adjuster, the Spirit of Truth, and the Holy Spirit bear witness to this fact with the human spirit.
t047.s1.i1: By accepting the status of sonship and believing in its reality, a person makes sonship with God an eternal reality.
t047.s1.i4: Salvation is the gift of the Father, and those who receive it by faith partake of the divine nature and become sons or daughters of God.
t047.s1.i5: The first condition for entering the kingdom is the faith and sincerity of coming as a little child and receiving the bestowal of sonship as a gift.
t047.s2.i1: It is a solemn and sublime fact that lowly and material man is a faith child of the Most High.
t047.s2.i2: Because the Creator Son became man and our elder brother, we who are his brothers are sons of the same Father.
t047.s2.i3: We are sons because the spirit of the Son has been poured out upon all races, because we have received personality from the Father, and because a fragment of the Father indwells us.
t047.s2.i4: Because the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of Truth, and the Adjuster are present together, mortals are qualified for the conscious realization of sonship with God.
t047.s2.i5: The spirit bears witness not "to" our spirits but "with" our spirits that we are children of God.
t047.s3.i1: The subjects of a kingdom hear the laws of a ruler, but one who discovers sonship by faith sees himself as the privileged son of a loving Father.
t047.s3.i2: When the Father's will is your law, you are a noble slave; when the Father's will becomes your will, you are a free child of God.
t047.s3.i3: As a good earthly father does not keep his children in anxiety, so the heavenly Father does not leave his faith children in doubt.
t047.s4.i1: Righteousness is not the condition of salvation but the natural fruit of the spirit-born life of sonship.
t047.s4.i3: The evidence to the world of being born of the spirit is that believers sincerely love one another.
t047.s4.i4: When we accept by living faith that our ideals come from a superhuman source, belief in sonship becomes effective and brotherhood becomes real.
t047.s4.i5: Religion is the experience that leads from the bondage of primitive fear to the liberty of faith that realizes sonship with God.
t047.s5.h: The Center of the Gospel Jesus Proclaimed
t047.s5.i1: By proclaiming that every mortal creature is a child of a loving Father, a son of God, Jesus raised the concept of the Father to a sublime experience.
t047.s5.i2: Jesus told his disciples first to make known that God is Father and man his son, and only then to discuss doctrine.
t047.s5.i3: Jesus said that people of other ages would better understand the gospel in family terms: the fatherhood of God, the brotherhood of man, and sonship with God.
t047.s5.i4: The gospel of the kingdom is the fact of the fatherhood of God joined with the truth of the sonship-brotherhood of men.
t047.s5.i5: The Spirit of Truth came to lead believers into a growing consciousness of eternal and ascending sonship with God.
t048.sum: The brotherhood of man is the universal relationship that follows from the fact that every personality is a child of the same heavenly Father. Because God loves each individual and that love reaches all, people are bound together as brothers. Jesus taught the fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of man as the center of the gospel, and its realization depends not on law or force but on mutual understanding and love, and on the spiritual transformation of mankind.
t048.s1.i1: God loves each person as an individual child, yet because that love reaches all, a universal brotherhood arises.
t048.s1.i2: Brotherhood is a relationship of the whole, not of the parts: the good of each helps all, and the evil of each adds to the suffering of all.
t048.s1.i4: When the belief that we are sons of God becomes effective, the feeling of brotherhood, an altruistic conviction, also becomes real.
t048.s2.i1: Jesus taught a new and greater brotherhood beyond the family of blood, the brotherhood of the sons of God.
t048.s2.i2: Jesus named two laws of the heavenly family, loving the Father and loving one's brother as oneself, and said that brotherly love shows itself in unselfish service.
t048.s2.i4: Jesus also used such expressions as the family of God, the fellowship of believers, and the brotherhood of man to refer to the kingdom.
t048.s2.i5: The religion Jesus founded consists in the personal experience of doing the will of God and serving the human brotherhood.
t048.s3.i2: Since the kingdom of heaven is a spiritual brotherhood of spirit-born sons, it can be proclaimed only by the power of the spirit, not by physical force.
t048.s3.i3: Jesus showed the way to the immediate attainment of spiritual brotherhood, but social brotherhood depends on many personal and planetary changes.
t048.s3.i4: Religious brotherhood cannot be realized unless all religions give up their claims of ecclesiastical authority and spiritual sovereignty.
t048.s4.i1: Social contact through travel, commerce, and exchange, and intellectual cross-fertilization through acquaintance with one another's thought, hasten brotherhood.
t048.s4.i2: Ignorance breeds suspicion, and suspicion cannot coexist with sympathy and love.
t048.s4.i3: Ethical awakening, political wisdom, and above all spiritual insight are needed for the realization of brotherhood.
t048.s4.i4: The quickest way to brotherhood is spiritual pressure from above, enlarging the soul's capacity to understand and love one another.
t048.s4.i5: On an isolated world like Urantia, religious revelation is essential for realizing brotherhood.
t048.s5.h: The Contagion of Love and Future Civilization
t048.s5.i1: No one can love his fellows by willpower alone; love is born of a thoroughgoing understanding of a neighbor's motives and sentiments.
t048.s5.i3: If every person became a focus of love, that love would encompass all civilization, and the brotherhood of man would be realized.
t048.s5.i4: The secret of a better civilization lies in Jesus' teachings about brotherhood, the good will of love and mutual trust.
t048.s5.i5: The progress of civilization leads to the social achievement of the brotherhood of man and the personal status of God-consciousness.
t048.s5.i6: The hope of modern Christianity lies in learning anew the living gospel of the fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of man.
t049.sum: The kingdom of God, or kingdom of heaven, is the central concept of the gospel Jesus proclaimed; above all it is the personal spiritual experience of the heavenly Father's will ruling in the believer's heart. It is founded on the fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of man, is entered now by faith, and bears fruit in loving service. In later times the kingdom concept was replaced by the institutional church, but the spiritual kingdom Jesus taught will yet be proclaimed again.
t049.s1.i1: Jesus used the kingdom of heaven and the kingdom of God with the same meaning, and made it the name for his bestowal mission.
t049.s1.i2: To his apostles Jesus taught the kingdom as a personal experience lived in relation to one's fellows and to the heavenly Father.
t049.s1.i4: Jesus tried to persuade his followers to use "the will of God" in place of "the kingdom," and to replace the idea of king and subjects with that of a heavenly family and liberated sons.
t049.s2.h: Foundations and Gifts of the Kingdom
t049.s2.i1: The kingdom of heaven begins with and is centered in the truth of the fatherhood of God and the fact of the brotherhood of man.
t049.s2.i2: This teaching frees man from age-old animal fears and gives him new courage and spiritual power.
t049.s2.i3: The gospel of the kingdom gives assurance and comfort even to the poor, and teaches the superiority of the spiritual over the material.
t049.s2.i4: When the Father's will is your law, you are barely in the kingdom; when the Father's will becomes your will, you are truly in the kingdom.
t049.s3.i2: The two conditions for entering the kingdom are childlike faith and sincerity, and a hunger for righteousness.
t049.s3.i3: Simple, childlike belief is the key that opens the door, but once inside there are steps of righteousness to climb.
t049.s3.i5: God's forgiveness is actually experienced in so far as one forgives one's fellows, and love of neighbor is the highest ethic.
t049.s4.h: Fruits and Stages of the Kingdom
t049.s4.i1: The inner religion of the kingdom increasingly shows itself in practical social service; Jesus taught religion as the cause and ethics as the result.
t049.s4.i3: Jesus taught two phases of the kingdom: the kingdom in this world and the kingdom in heaven.
t049.s4.i4: The kingdom has five phases: the inner experience of the individual, the brotherhood of believers, the superhuman brotherhood, a new social order, and the age of light and life.
t049.s4.i5: The kingdom is not a social or economic order but a spiritual brotherhood of God-knowing individuals.
t049.s5.i1: For Jesus the kingdom was the sum of individuals who had confessed faith in the fatherhood of God and dedicated themselves to doing his will.
t049.s5.i2: The rise of the church was itself natural, but the tragedy was that it almost wholly displaced Jesus' concept of the kingdom.
t049.s5.i3: Church membership does not mean fellowship in the kingdom; the one is spiritual, the other chiefly social.
t049.s5.i4: Some day a greater John the Baptist will appear, proclaiming a return to Jesus' concept of the kingdom as the Father's will ruling in the believer's heart.
t049.s5.i5: The outward church is only the larval stage of the thwarted spiritual kingdom, and the teachings of Jesus will never remain fruitless.
t050.sum: The will of God is the eternal purpose of the First Source and Center, and in the life of the individual it is partnership with the way and choice of God. The Urantia Book regards doing the will of God as the secret of survival and of perfection, and says that it is not a surrender of will but its consecration and expansion. Throughout his life Jesus lived "not my will but yours" and became the example of that way.
t050.s1.h: What the Will of God Is
t050.s1.i1: The will of God is the purpose of the First Source and Center, personalized in the Eternal Son and shown in universe action in the Infinite Spirit.
t050.s1.i3: Doing the will of God is therefore the experience of becoming more and more like God, the source of all that is good, beautiful, and true.
t050.s1.i4: Doing the will of God reveals a willingness to share one's inner life with God, and sharing is a divine thing.
t050.s1.i5: In his mind Jesus unified all the attributes of God in "the will of the Father in heaven."
t050.s2.h: The Gift of a Dedicated Will
t050.s2.i1: The loving dedication of the human will to doing the Father's will is the highest and the only truly valuable gift man can offer God.
t050.s2.i2: God requires no coerced worship or slavish service; man must of himself love and worship God.
t050.s2.i4: This choice lies less in the negation "not my will but yours" than in the positive affirmation "it is my will that your will be done."
t050.s2.i5: God too first consented to entrust a fragment of himself to the human will and to dwell within it.
t050.s3.h: The Fruits of a Life That Does His Will
t050.s3.i1: The imitation of God is the key to perfection, and doing his will is the secret of survival and perfection.
t050.s3.i2: Peace in this life, survival after death, perfection in the next life, and service in eternity are already achieved in spirit when one chooses to submit the will to the Father's will.
t050.s3.i3: By choosing to do the Father's will, the mortal personality may become one with the indwelling spirit and so become eternal.
t050.s3.i4: A life that lives the Father's will is founded on truth, sensitive to beauty, governed by goodness, and shown outwardly in loving service.
t050.s3.i5: In many cases the Thought Adjuster is dispatched at the very moment a person quietly resolves to do the Father's will.
t050.s4.h: The Adventure of Finding and Doing His Will
t050.s4.i2: The will of God can be done in any occupation, and for those who are spirit led there is no division between holy and secular callings.
t050.s4.i3: When one is wholly dedicated to the Father's will, prayer comes into harmony with that will, and every petition is answered.
t050.s4.i4: The idea of sacrifice impairs the efficacy of true prayer by offering material things instead of one's own will.
t050.s4.i5: The will of God does not prevail from moment to moment, but viewed over a whole lifetime it becomes ever clearer in the fruits of those who are led by the spirit.
t050.s5.h: Jesus, the Example of a Life Lived in the Father's Will
t050.s5.i2: In every situation of life the mind of Jesus held to "not my will but yours," and this consecration is the true passport to divine attainment.
t050.s5.i3: The great task of Michael's bestowal was to reveal God to the creatures of flesh by living a life that did the Father's will.
t050.s5.i4: By dedicating his will to doing the divine will, Jesus made the greatest offering man can make to God.
t050.s5.i5: Jesus tried to persuade his disciples to use "the will of God" in place of the word "kingdom."
